solutions.title: BFS from each one
solutions.strategy: For each one-cell, run BFS until the nearest zero is found.

timeComplexity.explanation: Each of mn cells can trigger a BFS over the whole matrix.

spaceComplexity.explanation: Each BFS can use a visited matrix and queue over the grid.

solutions.title: Multi-source BFS
solutions.strategy: Start BFS from every zero at once so first arrival gives each one-cell its nearest zero distance.

timeComplexity.explanation: Every matrix cell is enqueued at most once.

spaceComplexity.explanation: The output matrix and queue can cover the full grid.
